summary: Complete manual retrospective library annotation, preserving the unborrowed atlas plan, actual whale-book checkout, depicted characters, scoped reports and the unresolved bookmark continuity.

ambiguities.issue: Bookmark picked up from floor is later described as still inside the book.
ambiguities.decision: Retain one text-intended identity with evidence_resolution_status and evidence_missing; no duplicate bookmark or reinsertion event is invented.

ambiguities.issue: Atlas starts on a display table and ends on a display shelf; transition is unreported.
ambiguities.decision: Separate table/shelf referents; record request and final state without an invented completed reshelving action or atlas checkout.

ambiguities.issue: Is that it can ask whether the visible point is the bookmark or whether it indicates the book.
ambiguities.decision: Represent a tentative clue-to-book-location interpretation and explicit metonymic bridge; Mina’s uncertainty remains at its local time despite later confirmation.

ambiguities.issue: Cannot climb may express physical constraint or a safety/permission rule.
ambiguities.decision: Keep modal source unresolved; later librarian use of ladder does not prove a precise height or universal rule.

ambiguities.issue: book’s gone permits book is gone or book has gone.
ambiguities.decision: Choose missing-state is reading with recorded alternative, without an invented departure event.

ambiguities.issue: Image first shown is not explicitly located on cover versus an interior page.
ambiguities.decision: Depicted whale identity is shared, but illustration location is left open until explicit first-page final image.

ambiguities.issue: we in grandmother departure report is contextually Jun and grandmother.
ambiguities.decision: Use that pair, distinct from search-team we. Mina’s accompanying departure is not stated by this rule.

ambiguities.issue: Put back and put on astronomy shelf describe the same prior placement.
ambiguities.decision: Reuse one underlying placement event while preserving the earlier-belief scope.

feature_gaps.decision: Existing evidence_missing/evidence_resolution_status and feedback suffice for this trial; a typed transition-gap relation could be useful later but no extra attribute is required here.

feature_gaps.meaning: represented image versus physical page contact
feature_gaps.decision: Existing semantic_world_id plus reference_metonymic_link and part_whole_relation preserve the final bookmark/depicted-tail distinction; no runtime enactment claim is used.

prompt_feedback: Keep source continuity defects separate from character false belief and from a proven logical contradiction; missing transition evidence alone does not license a repair event.
Distinguish actual loans/checkouts, permission, considered reservations and endpoint shelf states. Holding an atlas does not establish borrowing it.
Quantified book/none denote variables or sets under restricted quantification, not a single book identity or the whole collection in an individual slot.
Negation and modality should point to the precise positive action/state content; an explicitly negative premise needs its own proposition when used in reasoning.
Separate grammatical direct objects from objects of prepositions, and finite tense from tense inferred for a participial clause.
A display table and display shelf can both be explicit without a narrated transfer between them. Avoid silently merging furniture to repair continuity.
coverage_notes: All 759 words received explicit contextual POS and lemmas. All 32 paragraphs and all 1,024 supplied feature definitions were read. Sparse annotation covers identities, predicates, roles, scope, grammar, time, quantities, physical relations, mental and communicative content, and evidence-marked narrative interpretation. No causal-prefix filter, API call or automatic semantic tagger. Gaps/punctuation remain deterministic.
not_claimed: literal swimming animal or speaking book in library
